What we look for

A playable build or a clear prototype, a developer who ships, and a game with something distinct to offer players.

How publishing conversations work

A clear, straightforward path from first introduction to a potential partnership.

01 · Introduce

Tell us who you are, what you are building and how to reach you. Include a short game overview.

02 · Share

If available, share a playable build, prototype footage, screenshots or a pitch deck. Do not send confidential material until an appropriate agreement is in place.

03 · Discuss

If the project looks like a potential fit, we can discuss goals, scope, responsibilities and possible next steps. No deal is implied until both sides agree in writing.

What to include in your first message

  • Game title, genre and target platforms
  • Current stage: idea, prototype, demo or near release
  • A short description of the core gameplay
  • Team size and relevant experience
  • Links to a trailer, gameplay video, build or portfolio (if available)
  • What kind of publishing support you are looking for

Please share only material you have the right to provide. Do not include passwords, personal identity documents or other sensitive information.

Frequently asked questions

Does Redkrane accept submissions from solo developers?

Yes. Solo developers, small teams and established studios are welcome to introduce original projects.

Which platforms do you consider?

Redkrane is open to original mobile and PC game projects. Include your target platform and current development stage in your message.

Does submitting a game guarantee a publishing deal?

No. A submission is an introduction, not an offer or commitment. Any partnership would require separate discussions and a written agreement.

What should I send?

Start with a short overview, genre, platforms, development stage and team information. A playable build, prototype footage or pitch deck can help if you have one.

Does Falkron Studio develop every game Redkrane publishes?

No. Falkron Studio is the development brand in this ecosystem. Redkrane's publishing focus is separate, and independent developers and external studios are welcome to approach us.

Privacy Policy and Terms of Use

Last updated: November 2026. This page explains how Redkrane handles your information and the rules for using this website.

Privacy Policy

What we collect

When you send a message through our contact form or the game submission form, we receive the details you type in: your name, your email address, the type of sender you choose or your studio name, the game details you share (title, genre, platform, stage and any link) and your message. We do not ask for anything more than this on the site.

How we use it

We use these details only to read and reply to your message, to discuss game submissions or partnerships, and to keep a record of those conversations. We do not sell your information.

Services that help us run the site

  • Our contact and submission forms are delivered through Web3Forms, which passes your message to us. Your details therefore pass through their service.
  • Fonts on this site load from Google Fonts, so Google may receive your IP address and browser details when the page loads.

These services have their own privacy policies, and we are not responsible for how they handle data.

How long we keep it

We keep messages for as long as needed to respond and to keep a reasonable record of partnership discussions. You can ask us to delete your message at any time.

Your choices

You can ask us to show, correct or delete the information we hold about you, or to stop contacting you, by sending a message through the Help & Support form. Where the law of India applies, including the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023, we will handle your request as that law requires.

Please do not send sensitive information

Do not include passwords, identity documents, payment details or other sensitive information in your message. Do not send confidential game material until we have agreed in writing to receive it.

Children

This site is meant for adults and developers. If you are under 18, please ask a parent or guardian before contacting us.

Changes

We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top shows when it was last changed.

Terms of Use

Using this website

By using this website you agree to these terms. Please use the site lawfully and do not try to disrupt it, break into it or misuse the contact form.

Submissions are introductions only

Sending us a game or an idea is an introduction. It is not an offer, and it does not create a publishing agreement, a partnership, an exclusive arrangement or any other commitment. No deal exists until both sides sign a written agreement. We may decline any submission without giving a reason.

What you send us

Share only material you have the right to share. You remain the owner of your game and your ideas. By sending a message you allow us to read it and to use it to evaluate and discuss your project with you. Please do not send confidential material until an appropriate agreement is in place.

Our content

The Redkrane name, logo, design and text on this site belong to Redkrane or its partners. Please do not copy or reuse them without permission.

No guarantees

We try to keep the information on this site accurate and the site available, but we provide it as it is, without promises about completeness or uninterrupted access.

Third-party links

Links on this site may lead to other websites. We do not control them and are not responsible for their content.

Limit of liability

To the extent the law allows, Redkrane is not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from your use of this website.

Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of India.

Questions

For questions about these terms or the privacy policy, send a message through the Help & Support form.
